definitions.gloss: teacher (official job title, kindergarten through high school)
definitions.explanation: The legal job title of a fully licensed, regularly employed teacher at a Japanese school below university level. It appears in personnel records, news reports, and formal introductions rather than in everyday speech.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{中学校|ちゅうがっこう}→中学校：01465_chuugakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{教諭|きょうゆ}だ。
examples.english: My father is a junior high school teacher.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧{教諭|きょうゆ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: From next year I'll be working as an elementary school teacher.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市内|しない}→市内：20934_shinai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勤|つと}める→勤める：00902_tsutomeru⟧{教諭|きょうゆ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{優|すぐ}れた→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{表彰|ひょうしょう}→表彰：17400_hyoushou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A teacher working at a high school in the city was honoured for the quality of his lessons.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧{教諭|きょうゆ}: elementary school teacher
- {養護|ようご}{教諭|きょうゆ}: school nurse-teacher
- {教諭|きょうゆ}⟦{免許|めんきょ}→免許：03808_menkyo⟧: teaching licence
- {教諭|きょうゆ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become a licensed teacher

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧: teacher — how you actually address or refer to one; never a job title on paper
- ⟦{教師|きょうし}→教師：03029_kyoushi⟧: teacher — the general occupational word, usable of any school and of private tutors
- ⟦{講師|こうし}→講師：00451_koushi⟧: lecturer, part-time instructor — a different employment category from {教諭|きょうゆ}

Register note: news stories append it directly to a surname, as in ⟦{山田|やまだ}→山田：09529_yamada⟧{教諭|きょうゆ}, the way English reports say "Ms Smith, a teacher at…".
